# StopwatchManager

> **File:** `services/apps/StopwatchManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

One one-off timer and one stopwatch, for every Stopwatch widget and module, both able to run at once. Their states (StopwatchClock's) hold absolute times, kept across a QML reload (PersistentProperties) and a restart (StateManager "stopwatch"). A timer's end notifies (with Stopwatch.notify) and runs with nothing showing it; displays acquire(owner, interval) a `now` ticking at the shortest interval asked (a stopwatch's tenths want 100 ms), only while one runs. axiom ipc stopwatch timer "10m tea"

### Functions

- `timerTextNow()`: The times as of this moment, for a reader holding no acquire (the launcher, IPC): `timerText` and `elapsedText` follow `now`, which ticks only while something has acquired it
- `elapsedTextNow()`
- `acquire(owner, interval)`: `interval`: ms between updates of `now` this owner wants
- `release(owner)`
- `startTimerText(text)`: Starts a timer from text ("10m", "1h30m tea", "1:30"); false when it doesn't start with a duration
- `startTimer(ms, label)`
- `toggleTimer()`: Pause ↔ resume; an idle timer starts its last duration again
- `addTimer(ms)`
- `resetTimer()`
- `toggleStopwatch()`
- `lap()`
- `resetStopwatch()`
- `openModule()`: A page or edge menu with a Stopwatch module; false with none
